article_content: The New York Metropolitan Transportation Authority is facing a minor embarrassment after a new license plate affixed to some of its fleet vehicles was spotted with a typo. The plates read 'Metropolitan Transporation Authority', with the second 't' in 'transportation' missing. The New York State Department of Motor Vehicles says the error originated within their system and is investigating whether it occurred during the design or manufacturing stage. A license plate with the spelling error is visible on an MTA fleet vehicle in New York. It's unclear how many license plates contain the typo. The New York State DMV says it ordered 908 license plates in the batch but doesn't know how many have the mistake or the replacement cost. Pix 11 reports some speculate the problem arose because the full word 'transportation' didn't fit the allotted space. The DMV has stated they ordered 908 plates and intend to replace the incorrect ones. However, officials couldn't provide the exact replacement number or reprinting cost. This incident comes a few months after Northwestern's Medill School of Journalism misspelled 'integrated' without the 'n' on some Integrated Marketing Communications program graduates' diplomas.

Na tablicama piše 'Metropolitan Transporation Authority', pri čemu nedostaje drugo 't' u riječi 'transportation'. Državni ured za motorna vozila New Yorka kaže da je greška nastala unutar njihovog sistema i istražuje da li se dogodila tokom dizajniranja ili proizvodnje. Registarska tablica sa slovnom greškom je vidljiva na jednom vozilu MTA u New Yorku. Nejasno je koliko registarskih tablica ima ovu slovnu grešku. Državni ured za motorna vozila New Yorka kaže da je naručio 908 registarskih tablica, ali ne zna koliko ih je pogrešno niti koliki su troškovi zamjene. Pix 11 izvještava da neki nagađaju kako je problem nastao jer cijela riječ 'transportation' nije stala na predviđeno mjesto. DMV je naveo da su naručili 908 tablica i planiraju zamijeniti one pogrešne. Međutim, službenici nisu mogli dati tačan broj potrebnih zamjena niti troškove ponovnog štampanja. Ovaj se incident dogodio nekoliko mjeseci nakon što je Medill School of Journalism pri Northwesternu pogrešno napisala riječ 'integrated' (bez slova 'n') na diplomama nekih studenata programa Integrisanog marketinga i komunikacija.

article_content: Kuwait's emir has accepted the resignation of the Cabinet and Prime Minister, tasking them with serving as a caretaker government until a new one is formed, according to the state news agency KUNA on Monday. This decision follows protests in Kuwait City less than two weeks prior, where anti-corruption demonstrators entered Parliament, demanding the Prime Minister's removal. Prime Minister Sheikh Nasser al-Mohammad al-Sabah has seen six previous governments collapse due to opposition over the years. The recent protests not only called for the government's downfall but also for the Prime Minister's resignation. Protesters chanted slogans reminiscent of the Arab Spring, demanding his 'overthrow'. While Kuwait's leaders attempted to quell the unrest, opposition leaders pledged to intensify their efforts. In a resignation letter to the emir, the Prime Minister cited 'negative practices' by a minority of Parliament members as preventing progress, KUNA reported. He accused the parliamentarians of fostering disunity, questioning the integrity of national leaders, and making baseless accusations. The Prime Minister stated that these circumstances made it impossible for the government to continue fulfilling its responsibilities, KUNA reported.

Ova odluka slijedi nakon protesta u Kuvajtu prije manje od dvije sedmice, gdje su antikorupcijski demonstranti ušli u Parlament, zahtijevajući smjenu premijera. Premijer Šeik Naser al-Mohammad al-Sabah je svjedočio padu šest prethodnih vlada zbog opozicije tokom godina. Nedavni protesti nisu samo pozivali na pad vlade, već i na ostavku premijera. Dok su kuvajtski lideri pokušavali smiriti nerede, opozicioni lideri su obećali da će pojačati svoje napore. article_content: Reports indicate ministers might allow the French and German governments to acquire shares in Britain's biggest defense firm. Simultaneously, the UK government may consent to not possessing a controlling interest in the company formed by the BAE Systems and EADS merger. The two corporations are likely to request a two-week extension from the stock market today concerning their £30 billion merger plans. Despite investor disapproval, the government conceded it's willing to compromise to facilitate the deal. Defence Secretary Philip Hammond stated the UK could accept Paris and Berlin each holding a 9% stake in the new entity. Senior government sources suggest David Cameron may personally engage with Francois Hollande and Angela Merkel to finalize an agreement. This will likely anger the 45 Tory MPs who previously demanded the PM prevent the deal unless France and Germany divest their shares. The opposition grew as Invesco Perpetual, BAE’s primary shareholder, criticized the merger, with Neil Woodford expressing 'significant reservations'. Invesco's objection intensifies the resistance to a merger that potentially endangers up to 50,000 British jobs. Although Britain would retain a 'golden share', it offers no financial benefit and only provides a theoretical veto on future acquisitions. The companies have until tomorrow to inform the stock market of their detailed strategies. Mr. Hammond stated that completing the deal by Wednesday is unlikely. He emphasized the need to protect British jobs, strategic interests, and defence capabilities. The government acknowledged its willingness to permit Paris and Berlin to hold shares in the new venture. Defence Secretary Philip Hammond wants to safeguard British interests. The French and Germans aim to retain control of up to 13.5% of the new company, an amount deemed unacceptable by the UK. Mr. Hammond clarified that the UK's limit is 9%. He suggested that if the French government reduces its stake and removes structures enabling it to control the company, a resolution might be achievable with additional safeguards, a national security agreement, and board composition assurances. Mr. Hammond stressed that the UK can't permit the business to proceed with France or Germany directing its operations. A senior Cabinet minister voiced concerns about negotiating with 'meddling' European politicians, noting their conviction that governments should possess shares in such companies. The minister added that the French and German perspective differs greatly, resembling the UK's stance in the 1970s before Thatcher's reforms. The government's position contrasts with that of investors and some MPs. Last night, Tory MP Ben Wallace urged a shift from heeding bankers to listening to investors, questioning the lessons learned from the financial crisis.

article_content: NEW DELHI: Former South African fast bowler Morne Morkel resigned from his position as the bowling coach for the Pakistan cricket team on Monday, just two days following the team's elimination from the World Cup in India. Under the leadership of Babar Azam, the Pakistani team experienced a difficult ODI World Cup, losing five of their nine matches. Their campaign concluded with a 93-run defeat against England in Kolkata. Morkel initially joined the team on a six-month contract in June of this year, after previously working with the IPL team Lucknow Super Giants. His involvement with the Pakistan team commenced with a two-Test series during their tour of Sri Lanka. The Pakistan Cricket Board will announce his replacement in due course. Pakistan is scheduled to play a three-match Test series against Australia from December 14, 2023, to January 7, 2024, in Australia,' the PCB stated on Monday. World Cup 2023: England extinguished Pakistan’s hopes, India to face New Zealand in the first semifinal. Pakistan did not qualify for the semifinals, finishing fifth, which prompted several former cricketers to call for significant changes within the team, including the removal of Babar Azam as captain. Pakistan suffered defeats against India, Australia, South Africa, and England, as well as a surprising loss to Afghanistan.(With PTI Inputs)

article_content: By Victoria Woollaston Within the next decade, the online video market as we know it could be transformed, potentially eliminating adverts, standard channels, and traditional menus. That’s according to Netflix’s chief product officer, Neil Hunt, who made these statements at Internet Week in New York. He predicts that by ‘2025 or sooner,’ services such as Netflix will have mastered personalization to the point where they anticipate what users want to watch before they even log in. Netflix's chief product officer, Neil Hunt, predicts that, within the next decade, grid-style menus will be replaced by highly personalized choices, predicting viewer preferences before they sign in. Hunt also claims that standard channels will be replaced by a 'different channel' for each of its 50 million subscribers. In April, Netflix signed a deal with three smaller cable providers in the U.S. to integrate its service as a regular TV channel. The agreements with Atlantic Broadband, RCN Telecom Services, and Grande Communications provide the internet streaming site's subscription service as a channel on TiVo boxes offered to these companies' customers. It debuted on Atlantic and RCN before expanding to Grande's service at the end of April. Essentially, everyone will get their own personalized channel. ‘Our vision is, you won’t see a grid, and you won’t see a sea of titles,’ said Hunt. Instead, Netflix will present viewers with up to four TV shows or films it believes they will enjoy, based on their viewing history, the time of day, the day of the week, and other factors. By linking to social networks, Netflix could even gauge a viewer’s mood based on their most recent posts or suggest films following a change in relationship status. However, this is still some time away, as Netflix's CEO, Reed Hastings, admitted at today's Recode Conference that only 'a few people' are sharing Netflix views on Facebook, and 'auto-sharing hasn’t yet panned out.' Regarding channels, Hunt believes that as personalization improves, fewer people will watch standard channels created by networks. Hunt, pictured, made the comments at the Internet Week event in New York. He suggested that adverts in online videos could be eliminated, and brands would need to find alternative methods to promote their goods. Alternatively, there could be fewer, but more personalized and targeted adverts. By linking to social networks, Netflix could learn a viewer's mood based on their most recent posts or suggest shows, such as its own House of Cards starring Kevin Spacey, based on political beliefs. Regarding channels, Hunt believes that as personalization improves, fewer people will watch standard channels. Instead, each Netflix subscriber - which at the end of April was approaching 50 million - would be served an individual channel, built specifically for them. Hunt also said that adverts could be eliminated following customer feedback, and brands would need to find alternative methods to promote their goods. Alternatively, there could be fewer, but more personalized and targeted adverts that generate the best conversion. When asked about the controversial topic of internet fast lanes for web traffic, Hunt said Netflix was in support of net neutrality. He added that Netflix should be the leading provider because it offers the best service, not because it can afford to pay for faster access. At today's event, Hastings said net neutrality wouldn’t be an issue if cable companies had competition for internet access in homes. Until 2010, AT&T and Verizon invested tens of billions of dollars to compete with cable, but ended the project when they admitted they couldn't compete. Hastings added that he is concerned cable operators will begin raising the prices for services such as Netflix, which could impact the prices they charge.
translated_content: Autor: Victoria Woollaston U sljedećoj deceniji, tržište online videa kakvo poznajemo moglo bi se transformisati, potencijalno eliminirajući reklame, standardne kanale i tradicionalne menije. To je prema riječima glavnog direktora za proizvode Netflixa, Neila Hunta, koji je ove izjave dao na konferenciji Internet Week u New Yorku. On predviđa da će do ‘2025. ili ranije’ servisi poput Netflixa usavršiti personalizaciju do te mjere da će predviđati šta korisnici žele gledati prije nego što se i prijave. Glavni direktor za proizvode Netflixa, Neil Hunt, predviđa da će u sljedećoj deceniji meniji u stilu mreže biti zamijenjeni visoko personalizovanim izborima, predviđajući preferencije gledalaca prije nego što se prijave. Hunt također tvrdi da će standardni kanali biti zamijenjeni ‘različitim kanalom’ za svakog od njegovih 50 miliona pretplatnika. U aprilu je Netflix potpisao ugovor sa tri manja kablovska operatera u SAD-u kako bi integrirao svoju uslugu kao redovni TV kanal. Sporazumi sa Atlantic Broadband, RCN Telecom Services i Grande Communications omogućavaju pretplatničkoj usluzi streaming servisa da bude dostupna kao kanal na TiVo uređajima koje ove kompanije nude svojim korisnicima. Usluga je prvo pokrenuta na Atlanticu i RCN-u, a zatim je krajem aprila proširena na Grande. U suštini, svako će dobiti svoj personalizovani kanal. ‘Naša vizija je da nećete vidjeti mrežu i nećete vidjeti more naslova,’ rekao je Hunt. Umjesto toga, Netflix će gledaocima prikazivati do četiri TV emisije ili filma za koje vjeruje da će im se svidjeti, na osnovu njihove historije gledanja, doba dana, dana u sedmici i drugih faktora. Povezivanjem sa društvenim mrežama, Netflix bi čak mogao procijeniti raspoloženje gledatelja na osnovu njihovih najnovijih objava ili predložiti filmove nakon promjene statusa veze. Međutim, to je još uvijek daleka budućnost, jer je izvršni direktor Netflixa, Reed Hastings, priznao na Recode konferenciji da samo 'nekoliko ljudi' dijeli stavove Netflixa na Facebooku, te da 'automatsko dijeljenje još nije zaživjelo.' Što se tiče kanala, Hunt vjeruje da će, kako se personalizacija bude poboljšavala, sve manje ljudi gledati standardne kanale koje kreiraju TV kuće. Hunt je, tokom konferencije Internet Week u New Yorku, sugerisao da bi se reklame u online videozapisima mogle ukinuti, te da bi brendovi trebali pronaći alternativne načine za promociju svojih proizvoda. Alternativno, mogao bi postojati manji broj, ali personalizovanih i ciljanih reklama. Povezivanjem sa društvenim mrežama, Netflix bi mogao saznati raspoloženje gledatelja na osnovu njihovih najnovijih objava ili predložiti emisije, kao što je njihova serija ‘House of Cards’ s Kevinom Spaceyjem, na osnovu političkih uvjerenja. Što se tiče kanala, Hunt vjeruje da će, kako se personalizacija bude poboljšavala, sve manje ljudi gledati standardne kanale. Umjesto toga, svaki pretplatnik Netflixa – kojih je krajem aprila bilo blizu 50 miliona – imao bi svoj individualni kanal, kreiran posebno za njega. Hunt je također rekao da bi se reklame mogle ukinuti na osnovu povratnih informacija korisnika, te da bi brendovi trebali pronaći alternativne načine za promociju svojih proizvoda. Alternativno, mogao bi postojati manji broj, ali personalizovanih i ciljanih reklama koje generišu najbolju konverziju. Na pitanje o kontroverznoj temi brzog interneta za web promet, Hunt je rekao da Netflix podržava neutralnost mreže. Dodao je da bi Netflix trebao biti vodeći pružatelj usluga jer nudi najbolju uslugu, a ne zato što si može priuštiti da plati brži pristup. Hastings je izjavio da neutralnost mreže ne bi bila problem kada bi kablovske kompanije imale konkurenciju za pristup internetu u domovima. Do 2010. godine, AT&T i Verizon su uložili desetine milijardi dolara kako bi konkurisali kablovskim operaterima, ali su prekinuli projekat kada su priznali da se ne mogu takmičiti. Hastings je dodao da je zabrinut da će kablovski operateri početi podizati cijene za usluge kao što je Netflix, što bi moglo uticati na cijene koje oni naplaćuju.

article_content: Paul McGrath had concerns that Roy Keane might have been taking on too much by working both for the Irish Football Association and Aston Villa. 'Having two jobs meant he wasn't getting any rest,' McGrath, who previously played for both Villa and Ireland, stated. 'He was dedicated to getting Ireland to the Euros while also doing his best for Villa.' McGrath commented that Keane would find it challenging to manage two different roles effectively. He added, 'The Ireland job is demanding because you have to scout players, check their eligibility, even looking into grandparent eligibility rules. He needs to watch them play.' 'Adding the Villa job on top was a big ask. It now appears it was too much for Roy. He has come to the conclusion that he can’t juggle both. I’m happy he has decided to stay with Ireland,' McGrath said. When asked if Keane might regret his decision, McGrath responded, 'Yes, I think he might. However, Roy probably feels he has made the right decision, enabling him to focus on Ireland, which was his initial commitment.' McGrath, who participated with Keane in the '94 World Cup, was surprised by the timing of the resignation and believes Villa manager Paul Lambert was also unprepared. 'I was taken aback when I heard the news this morning because Villa is facing difficulties, and this adds another unexpected challenge for the Villa fans. The former Manchester United captain served as assistant manager for both Ireland and Aston Villa. 'I believe the Villa staff, especially Paul Lambert, were caught off guard, as this creates yet another significant hurdle. While I am disappointed that Roy has left, I remain optimistic that we can overcome our current struggles.' Villa is scheduled to play at Burnley on Saturday, with the understanding that a defeat could push the club into the relegation zone. 'This is a crucial game for us because we have stopped our losing streak by drawing the last two games. Now, we must defeat Burnley to distance ourselves from the bottom of the league,' McGrath stated. Former midfielder Ian Taylor, who played alongside McGrath in the Villa team that won the 1996 League Cup, suspects there is more to the story than is being revealed. 'It’s quite odd. One can only wonder about the real reasons,' said Taylor, who now serves as a Villa club ambassador. 'He mentioned that he couldn't handle both roles, but I suspect there is more to it than that, although we have to accept what he (Keane) says. Why not wait until after tomorrow and Tuesday, since those are two important games for us? The timing is really unfortunate.' McGrath believed that Villa manager Paul Lambert would have been shocked by Keane's unexpected departure. Taylor thinks Villa supporters will miss Keane the most. 'They were always chanting his name, they admired his attitude; he was always confronting the fourth official. They really liked him, perhaps even more than the manager, to be honest,' he said. 'The fourth officials probably dreaded Villa games because he (Keane) was always so combative.' 'I ran into him a few weeks ago at the team hotel, and we had a good chat about everything. He was saying “what’s all the fuss about? We have good players at the club, and it’s only a matter of time before we turn things around.”’ Striker Darren Bent, who departed Villa yesterday on loan to Brighton, praised the former Villa assistant manager. 'Roy was great for me. He was always honest. If you want to improve as a player, you need people like him to tell you the truth. I got along well with him, and his departure is a loss for the club.'

Bivši vezni igrač Ian Taylor, koji je igrao uz McGratha u timu Ville koji je osvojio Liga kup 1996. godine, sumnja da se iza ove priče krije više nego što se otkriva. 'Prilično je čudno. Može se samo pitati o pravim razlozima,' rekao je Taylor, koji sada služi kao ambasador kluba Villa. 'Spomenuo je da ne može obavljati obje uloge, ali sumnjam da se iza toga krije više od toga, iako moramo prihvatiti ono što on (Keane) kaže. Zašto ne pričekati do poslije sutra i utorka, budući da su to dvije važne utakmice za nas? Vrijeme je stvarno nesretno.' Imamo dobre igrače u klubu i samo je pitanje vremena kada ćemo preokrenuti stvari.”' Napadač Darren Bent, koji je jučer napustio Villu na posudbu u Brighton, pohvalio je bivšeg pomoćnog trenera Ville. 'Roy je bio sjajan prema meni. Uvijek je bio iskren. Ako želite postati bolji igrač, potrebni su vam ljudi poput njega da vam kažu istinu. article_content: The Chamber of Commerce is launching an ad campaign featuring Kentucky Senator Rand Paul, a figure popular among libertarians, to bolster support for Alaska Republican Senate candidate Dan Sullivan. Sullivan faces a challenge from a libertarian third-party candidate. Republicans and their allies are actively trying to limit the extent to which third-party candidates draw support away from GOP candidates in states where Senate control is at stake. In the advertisement, Paul employs language appealing to libertarians to endorse Sullivan, who is engaged in a close race against incumbent Democratic Senator Mark Begich, who is serving his first term. Mark Fish, former chairman of the state's libertarian party, is also running, presenting a wild card scenario; even a small number of votes diverted from Sullivan could significantly impact the outcome of this crucial race. "Washington is profoundly dysfunctional. I am Rand Paul, and I am committed to changing that. However, meaningful change is impossible when Mark Begich consistently votes with his liberal Democratic colleagues 91% of the time," Paul states in the ad. "Washington seizes too many of our freedoms and too much of our money. I believe Dan Sullivan will restore those. To change Washington, change your Senator." "In states like Alaska, the Chamber is concentrating on the independent swing vote, and we believe Senator Paul is uniquely positioned to deliver a message that resonates with them. This aligns with our strategy this year of utilizing credible messengers in targeted races," Chamber spokeswoman Blair Latoff Holmes explained in a statement. Beyond Alaska, some Republicans are concerned that libertarian candidates could undermine support for GOP candidates in key Senate battlegrounds such as North Carolina, Georgia, and Kentucky. The Chamber's investment in the Paul ad for Alaska is in the seven-figure range, and the ad will be broadcast statewide starting Friday, both on television and online.

Sullivan se suočava s izazovom kandidata treće stranke – libertarijanaca. U reklami, Paul koristi jezik koji je privlačan libertarijancima kako bi podržao Sullivana, koji je u tijesnoj utrci sa aktuelnim demokratskim senatorom Markom Begichom, kojem je ovo prvi mandat. Mark Fish, bivši predsjednik libertarijanske stranke te države, također se kandiduje, što predstavlja faktor neizvjesnosti; čak i mali broj glasova koji bi inače pripali Sullivanu mogao bi značajno utjecati na ishod ove važne utrke. Međutim, značajna promjena je nemoguća kada Mark Begich dosljedno glasa sa svojim liberalnim demokratskim kolegama u 91% slučajeva," navodi Paul u reklami. Ovo se uklapa u našu ovogodišnju strategiju korištenja kredibilnih glasnogovornika u ciljanim utrkama," objasnila je glasnogovornica Komore Blair Latoff Holmes u izjavi. Pored Aljaske, neki republikanci su zabrinuti da bi kandidati libertarijanaca mogli umanjiti podršku GOP kandidatima u ključnim utrkama za Senat, kao što su one u Sjevernoj Karolini, Georgiji i Kentuckyju. Ulaganje Komore u Paulovu reklamu za Aljasku iznosi sedam cifara, a reklama će se emitovati širom države počevši od petka, na televiziji i online.

article_content: German cities have voiced anxieties that the ‘social peace’ is jeopardized by the increasing number of economic migrants arriving from Bulgaria and Romania. Reports caution the UK, highlighting problems such as widespread illegal work, school disruptions caused by language barriers, and a concerning increase in organized crime since the arrival of these migrants. Cities like Dortmund, Hanover, Berlin, and Hamburg are struggling to manage a six-fold increase in economic migration from these two countries since 2006. A Roma community exists in Bulgaria. Both Bulgaria and Romania are relatively poor, making employment in Germany and the UK appealing. The situation is worsened by the euro crisis, compelling Bulgarians and Romanians to seek improved living conditions in the nearest large economy. A report from the German Association of Cities indicates they are facing ‘significant costs due to this poverty migration’. They are seeking financial aid from Chancellor Angela Merkel, warning that ‘the social balance and social peace is severely threatened’. This comes as UK councils also request assistance in anticipation of a migrant influx from Bulgaria and Romania when they gain unrestricted access to the UK job market starting next year. Westminster City Council is already incurring expenses to purchase return tickets for Romanian rough sleepers arriving at Victoria Coach station. They caution that more arrivals will further strain already overburdened schools and housing services. From January 1, 2014, Bulgarians and Romanians in Britain will generally be eligible for benefits if employed, self-employed, seeking work, have an address, and intend to remain. Subject to means testing, they could receive benefits like Jobseeker’s Allowance, housing benefit, working tax credits, etc. In Germany, immigrants can receive child benefits until the child turns 18, or 25 if still studying. This amounts to approximately £160 monthly for each of the first two children, £165 for the third, and £187 for subsequent children. A scheme restricting EU citizens from receiving jobless benefits until one year of German employment is under legal dispute. Romania and Bulgaria offer limited government welfare; child benefit is about £3.50 per week in Bulgaria and £3.69 in Romania. Councillor Nickie Aitken stated the necessity for ‘firm answers’ from the Government regarding numbers and potential aid for overstretched schools and housing. Bulgaria and Romania joined the EU in 2007, but ‘transitional controls’ kept most low-skilled workers requiring UK work permits. Starting January 1, almost 30 million Romanians and Bulgarians will be eligible to freely live and work in the UK. Ministers have not estimated the expected number, but Migrationwatch suggests it could be as high as 70,000 annually. Officially, there are 42,000 Bulgarians in the UK, potentially reaching 80,000. An estimated 93,000 Romanians are already in the UK. Germany hosts over 90,000 Bulgarians and 159,000 Romanians. As in Britain, they are initially restricted from legal employment until January 1. They can remain under EU rules by declaring ‘self-employment’. However, the German cities’ report notes ‘The Roma, in particular, end up in desolate conditions once they are here.’ Police allege Romanian gangs send children to steal daily. Last year, new Romanian and Bulgarian arrivals in Munster formed a tent city beside a canal.
translated_content: Njemački gradovi su izrazili zabrinutost da je ‘socijalni mir’ ugrožen zbog sve većeg broja ekonomskih migranata koji dolaze iz Bugarske i Rumunije. Izvještaji upozoravaju Veliku Britaniju, ističući probleme poput rasprostranjenog ilegalnog rada, poremećaja u školama uzrokovanih jezičkim barijerama i zabrinjavajućeg porasta organiziranog kriminala od dolaska tih migranata. Gradovi poput Dortmunda, Hannovera, Berlina i Hamburga bore se s upravljanjem šesterostrukim povećanjem ekonomske migracije iz te dvije zemlje od 2006. godine. Romska zajednica postoji u Bugarskoj. I Bugarska i Rumunija su relativno siromašne, što zapošljavanje u Njemačkoj i Velikoj Britaniji čini privlačnim. Situaciju pogoršava eurokriza, prisiljavajući Bugare i Rumune da traže bolje uvjete života u najbližem velikom gospodarstvu. Izvještaj Njemačkog udruženja gradova pokazuje da se suočavaju sa ‘značajnim troškovima zbog te migracije siromaštva’. Traže financijsku pomoć od kancelarke Angele Merkel, upozoravajući da je ‘socijalna ravnoteža i socijalni mir ozbiljno ugrožen’. Ovo dolazi u trenutku kada i vijeća u Velikoj Britaniji traže pomoć u iščekivanju priljeva migranata iz Bugarske i Rumunije kada dobiju neograničen pristup tržištu rada Velike Britanije od sljedeće godine. Gradsko vijeće Westminster već ima troškove za kupovinu povratnih karata za rumunjske beskućnike koji stižu na autobusni kolodvor Victoria. Upozoravaju da će više dolazaka dodatno opteretiti već preopterećene škole i stambene usluge. Od 1. siječnja 2014. godine, Bugari i Rumunji u Britaniji će općenito imati pravo na beneficije ako su zaposleni, samozaposleni, traže posao, imaju adresu i namjeravaju ostati. Uz provjeru imovinskog stanja, mogli bi primati beneficije kao što su naknada za traženje posla, stambena naknada, porezni krediti za zaposlene, itd. U Njemačkoj, imigranti mogu primati dječji doplatak dok dijete ne navrši 18 godina, ili 25 ako još studira. To iznosi otprilike 160 funti mjesečno za svako od prva dva djeteta, 165 funti za treće i 187 funti za sljedeću djecu. Shema koja ograničava građanima EU primanje naknade za nezaposlene dok ne navrše godinu dana zaposlenja u Njemačkoj je pod pravnim sporom. Rumunija i Bugarska nude ograničenu državnu socijalnu pomoć; dječji doplatak je oko 3,50 funti tjedno u Bugarskoj i 3,69 funti u Rumuniji. Vijećnica Nickie Aitken izjavila je da je neophodno dobiti ‘određene odgovore’ od Vlade u vezi s brojevima i potencijalnom pomoći za preopterećene škole i stambene objekte. Bugarska i Rumunija pridružile su se EU 2007. godine, ali su ‘prijelazne kontrole’ zadržale većinu niskokvalificiranih radnika kojima su potrebne radne dozvole za Veliku Britaniju. Počevši od 1. siječnja, skoro 30 milijuna Rumunja i Bugara imat će pravo slobodno živjeti i raditi u Velikoj Britaniji. Ministri nisu procijenili očekivani broj, ali Migrationwatch sugerira da bi mogao biti visok i do 70.000 godišnje. Službeno, u Velikoj Britaniji ima 42.000 Bugara, potencijalno dostižući 80.000. Procjenjuje se da u Velikoj Britaniji već ima 93.000 Rumunja. Njemačka je domaćin za preko 90.000 Bugara i 159.000 Rumunja. Kao i u Britaniji, u početku im je zabranjeno legalno zapošljavanje do 1. siječnja. Mogu ostati prema pravilima EU proglašavajući se ‘samozaposlenima’. Međutim, izvještaj njemačkih gradova navodi: ‘Posebno Romi završe u teškim uvjetima kada dođu ovdje.’ Policija tvrdi da rumunjske bande šalju djecu da svakodnevno kradu. Prošle godine, novi rumunjski i bugarski pridošlice u Munsteru formirali su šatorsko naselje pored kanala.

article_content: New research suggests that drugs used to treat HIV could potentially be used to treat multiple sclerosis (MS). Researchers have discovered that individuals infected with HIV have a significantly lower risk of developing this debilitating nerve condition. They propose that the chronic suppression of the immune system, either as a result of HIV itself or the antiretroviral drugs used in its treatment, could be the reason for the reduced risk. Multiple sclerosis, caused by the body's immune system attacking myelin, the fatty insulation surrounding nerve fibres, might be treatable with HIV drugs, according to new research. The MS Society stated that while further research is necessary, the study indicates that antiretrovirals could represent a possible future treatment option for MS. The condition arises when the body's own defenses attack myelin. The stripping away of myelin impairs the proper transmission of nerve impulses, leading to symptoms that range from mild tingling to complete paralysis. MS can cause attacks or relapses resulting in the progressive loss of physical skills, sensation, vision, bladder control, and intellectual abilities. Drugs that suppress the immune system can slow down early forms of the disease, but there are limited treatment options for patients in the later stages. Antiretroviral medications may contribute to the lower likelihood of HIV patients developing MS. In the recent study, researchers from Queen Mary University of London, the University of Oxford, and the Prince of Wales Hospital in Sydney, Australia, examined data from over 21,000 HIV-positive patients treated in English hospitals between 1999 and 2011. These patients were then compared to more than five million control subjects. The study, published in the Journal Of Neurology Neurosurgery And Psychiatry, revealed that individuals with HIV were 62 percent less likely to develop MS than the control group. The authors stated: 'HIV infection is associated with a significantly decreased risk of developing MS.' Possible mechanisms for this potentially protective association include immunosuppression induced by chronic HIV infection and antiretroviral medications.' Dr. Emma Gray, research communications manager at the MS Society, commented on the study: 'This is a valuable and intriguing new study, and the first to demonstrate a significant link between HIV and a reduced risk of MS.' Much more research is needed to definitively prove whether having HIV or being treated for HIV with antiretrovirals, or even a combination of the two, reduces the risk of someone developing MS. We know that people with MS desire new, effective treatments, and this study offers some encouragement that antiretrovirals could be a potential future option. She added: 'Clinical trials are the only way to determine this, and the good news is that there is a London-based trial ongoing which is aimed at testing one such drug.'
translated_content: Novo istraživanje sugeriše da bi se lijekovi koji se koriste za liječenje HIV-a potencijalno mogli koristiti za liječenje multiple skleroze (MS). Istraživači su otkrili da osobe zaražene HIV-om imaju značajno manji rizik od razvoja ovog iscrpljujućeg nervnog oboljenja. Oni pretpostavljaju da bi hronično suzbijanje imunološkog sistema, bilo kao rezultat samog HIV-a ili antiretrovirusnih lijekova koji se koriste u njegovom liječenju, mogao biti razlog za smanjeni rizik. Multipla skleroza, uzrokovana napadom imunološkog sistema tijela na mijelin, masnu izolaciju koja okružuje nervna vlakna, mogla bi se liječiti lijekovima za HIV, prema novom istraživanju. Iz MS društva su izjavili da, iako je potrebno dalje istraživanje, studija pokazuje da bi antiretrovirusni lijekovi mogli predstavljati moguću buduću opciju liječenja za MS. Stanje nastaje kada vlastita odbrana tijela napadne mijelin. Uklanjanje mijelina narušava pravilan prijenos nervnih impulsa, što dovodi do simptoma koji se kreću od blagog trnjenja do potpune paralize. MS može uzrokovati napade ili relapse koji rezultiraju progresivnim gubitkom fizičkih vještina, osjeta, vida, kontrole mokraćnog mjehura i intelektualnih sposobnosti. Lijekovi koji suzbijaju imunološki sistem mogu usporiti rane oblike bolesti, ali postoji ograničen broj mogućnosti liječenja za pacijente u kasnijim fazama. Antiretrovirusni lijekovi mogu doprinijeti manjoj vjerovatnoći da će pacijenti sa HIV-om razviti MS. U nedavnoj studiji, istraživači sa Queen Mary University of London, University of Oxford i Prince of Wales Hospital u Sydneyu, Australija, ispitali su podatke od preko 21.000 HIV-pozitivnih pacijenata liječenih u engleskim bolnicama između 1999. i 2011. godine. Ovi pacijenti su zatim upoređeni sa više od pet miliona kontrolnih subjekata. Studija, objavljena u časopisu Journal Of Neurology Neurosurgery And Psychiatry, otkrila je da je kod osoba sa HIV-om 62 posto manja vjerovatnoća da će razviti MS u odnosu na kontrolnu grupu. Autori su izjavili: 'HIV infekcija je povezana sa značajno smanjenim rizikom od razvoja MS.' Mogući mehanizmi za ovu potencijalno zaštitnu povezanost uključuju imunosupresiju izazvanu hroničnom HIV infekcijom i antiretrovirusnim lijekovima.' Dr. Emma Gray, menadžer za komunikacije istraživanja u MS društvu, prokomentarisala je studiju: 'Ovo je vrijedna i intrigantna nova studija i prva koja je pokazala značajnu vezu između HIV-a i smanjenog rizika od MS.' Potrebno je mnogo više istraživanja kako bi se definitivno dokazalo da li posjedovanje HIV-a ili liječenje HIV-a antiretrovirusnim lijekovima, ili čak kombinacija to dvoje, smanjuje rizik od razvoja MS. Znamo da ljudi sa MS žele nove, efikasne tretmane, a ova studija nudi određeno ohrabrenje da bi antiretrovirusni lijekovi mogli biti potencijalna buduća opcija. Ona je dodala: 'Klinička ispitivanja su jedini način da se to utvrdi, a dobra vijest je da je u Londonu u toku ispitivanje koje ima za cilj testiranje jednog takvog lijeka.'

article_content: A call centre, made famous by a BBC reality TV series, has been fined £225,000 for harassing families with unsolicited marketing calls. The BBC's portrayal of the company’s millionaire boss, ‘Big Nev’ Wilshire, has depicted him as a lovable rogue and consumer champion. However, the reality is that the call centre's practices are causing distress, despite staff being shown dancing, wearing costumes, and participating in motivational games. ‘The Call Centre‘ series has promoted Wilshire and his Swansea-based business, Save Britain Money Ltd. Wilshire's companies targeted individuals registered with a watchdog to block marketing calls. Staff used brand names like ‘We Claim You Gain’ to cold call homes, seeking potential PPI claims. They also promoted energy-saving home improvement schemes under the name Nationwide Energy Services. Leads generated are sold to third-party firms, creating significant profits for the company, which has a turnover exceeding £25 million annually. These calls caused annoyance, with evidence suggesting some elderly individuals felt harassed. We Claim You Gain (WCYG) received a £100,000 fine, the first penalty for PPI-related nuisance calls. Nationwide Energy Services (NES) received a higher fine of £125,000. The Information Commissioners Office (ICO) issued the fines as part of a broader effort to combat cold calling. ICO director of operations, Simon Entwisle, stated that the public is fed up with nuisance calls. Entwisle added that while Nev and his employees' activities may be entertaining, they mask a larger issue within the industry. The ICO seeks greater governmental powers to penalize companies violating marketing call regulations. Millions registered with the Telephone Preference Service (TPS) to block unwanted calls. Wilshire's staff failed to check call targets against the TPS list. Approximately 2,700 complaints were filed, likely representing a fraction of those wrongly contacted. The company reported a £25 million turnover last year and was recognized as the second-best place to work in the UK by The Sunday Times. The BBC Three series portrays the call centre as a comic soap opera, highlighting staff difficulties as entertainment. ‘Big Nev’ is depicted as an eccentric benefactor offering career opportunities. He has gained celebrity status and appeared on shows like The One Show and BBC Breakfast. Publicity material portrays him as a hands-on boss involved in employees' lives. Wilshire has capitalized on the publicity, promoting himself as a familiar face to TV viewers. The company claims to help consumers save money, with 700 staff calling 15,000 people weekly and another 500 contacting 10,000 homes. Which? executive director Richard Lloyd emphasized the public's frustration with nuisance calls and urged government and telecoms to take action. Mr. Wilshire’s firm stated that neither NES nor WCUG agree with the fines and will appeal. The BBC defended its series, stating it was a balanced representation of the workplace.
translated_content: Pozivni centar, koji je postao poznat po BBC-jevoj reality TV seriji, kažnjen je sa 225.000 funti zbog uznemiravanja porodica neželjenim marketinškim pozivima. BBC-jev prikaz milionera i šefa kompanije, 'Big Nev' Wilshirea, prikazao ga je kao simpatičnog lupeža i borca za potrošače. Međutim, stvarnost je da prakse pozivnog centra uzrokuju nevolju, unatoč tome što se osoblje prikazuje kako pleše, nosi kostime i sudjeluje u motivacijskim igrama. Serija 'The Call Centre' promovirala je Wilshirea i njegov posao sa sjedištem u Swanseaju, Save Britain Money Ltd. Wilshireove kompanije su ciljale pojedince registrirane kod nadzornog tijela da blokiraju marketinške pozive. Osoblje je koristilo nazive brendova poput 'We Claim You Gain' za hladne pozive domovima, tražeći potencijalne zahtjeve za PPI (osiguranje zaštite plaćanja). Također su promovirali šeme za poboljšanje energetske efikasnosti doma pod imenom Nationwide Energy Services. Generirani kontakti se prodaju trećim firmama, stvarajući značajnu dobit za kompaniju, koja ima promet veći od 25 miliona funti godišnje. Ovi pozivi su izazvali smetnju, a dokazi sugeriraju da su se neki stariji pojedinci osjećali uznemireno. We Claim You Gain (WCYG) je dobio kaznu od 100.000 funti, prvu kaznu za neželjene pozive vezane za PPI. Nationwide Energy Services (NES) je dobio veću kaznu od 125.000 funti. Ured povjerenika za informacije (ICO) izdao je kazne kao dio šireg napora za borbu protiv hladnog pozivanja. Direktor operacija ICO-a, Simon Entwisle, izjavio je da je javnosti dosta neželjenih poziva. Entwisle je dodao da, iako aktivnosti Neva i njegovih zaposlenika mogu biti zabavne, one prikrivaju veći problem unutar industrije. ICO traži veće vladine ovlasti za kažnjavanje kompanija koje krše propise o marketinškim pozivima. Milioni su se registrovali kod Službe za preferencije poziva (TPS) da blokiraju neželjene pozive. Wilshireovo osoblje nije provjerilo ciljeve poziva u odnosu na listu TPS-a. Podneseno je približno 2.700 žalbi, što vjerovatno predstavlja samo dio onih koji su pogrešno kontaktirani. Kompanija je prijavila promet od 25 miliona funti prošle godine i prepoznata je kao drugo najbolje mjesto za rad u Velikoj Britaniji od strane The Sunday Timesa. BBC Three serija prikazuje pozivni centar kao komičnu sapunicu, ističući poteškoće osoblja kao zabavu. 'Big Nev' je prikazan kao ekscentrični dobrotvor koji nudi mogućnosti za karijeru. Stekao je status slavne osobe i pojavio se u emisijama poput The One Show i BBC Breakfast. Promotivni materijal ga prikazuje kao praktičnog šefa koji je uključen u živote zaposlenika. Wilshire je iskoristio publicitet, promovirajući se kao poznato lice TV gledaocima. Kompanija tvrdi da pomaže potrošačima da uštede novac, sa 700 zaposlenih koji pozivaju 15.000 ljudi sedmično, a drugih 500 kontaktira 10.000 domova. Izvršni direktor Which?-a, Richard Lloyd, naglasio je frustraciju javnosti zbog neželjenih poziva i pozvao vladu i telekome da poduzmu mjere. Firma gospodina Wilshirea je izjavila da se ni NES ni WCUG ne slažu s kaznama i da će se žaliti. BBC je branio svoju seriju, navodeći da je to uravnotežen prikaz radnog mjesta.

article_content: Have you ever found yourself drawn into yet another video of a social media influencer consuming a huge amount of, say, 100 different kinds of shrimp? It's hard to look away. Before you know it, you're craving seafood, making reservations at a new restaurant, and searching for recipes. The word for this phenomenon is: mukbang. UNLV journalism and media studies professors Linda Dam and Benjamin Burroughs can explain why people are so attracted to these videos. Recently, they—along with Anne Marie Basaran Borsai from the University of Connecticut—published their research article, "(Over)Eating with our Eyes: An examination of Mukbang Influencer Marketing and Consumer Engagement with Food Brands," in the Journal of Promotion Management. A mukbang is a video, often found on YouTube and TikTok, in which a host eats a large quantity of food while interacting with the audience. According to Burroughs and Dam, popular mukbang influencers often use specific techniques to develop parasocial interactions with their followers. Parasocial relationships are non-reciprocal relationships that typically develop with media personalities—the kind where you feel like you know someone well even though you've never met them. For instance, a host, often a paid influencer, will exaggerate opening packages, chew loudly, and emphasize other sounds to create an ASMR experience. An 'autonomous sensory meridian response' refers to the tingling or euphoric sensation triggered by certain stimuli—such as fingernails tapping, crunching noises, or whispering. They will also review the food they're eating in a one-way conversation with the audience. About the Research Dam and Burroughs conducted an online survey of 404 U.S. participants who regularly watch mukbang videos. The researchers' survey assessed: Trustworthiness Information credibility Parasocial interaction Video attitudes Brand attitudes Behavioral intentions Researchers asked respondents whether they trusted the influencers and if the information provided was believable. They also asked if the videos were dull or exciting and if the brands featured were appealing or not. Participants were asked how likely they would be to eat similar food shown in the video. The study found that higher ratings in these areas correlated with a stronger parasocial relationship, which enhances an influencer's ability to sell a product and positively impacts a brand's popularity. As a result of these parasocial relationships, viewers feel connected to the influencer, develop a sense of intimacy, trust the influencer's recommendations, and are more likely to purchase and consume the product being promoted. What can society learn from the study? The researchers' findings offer practical insights for aspiring social media food influencers and the brands that hire them. More importantly, Burroughs notes, it contributes to a broader discussion about how society—including children and adults—can become more media literate. "We want people to be informed and critical consumers of this new form of content," Burroughs said. "I think it's an integral part of digital literacy, enabling people to understand the content they consume, why it's being created, who is behind its production, and the potential economic or branded interests involved." Dam explained that the study encourages viewers to consider the psychological effects of mukbang and "to recognize that the large quantities of food consumed are part of the act of creating content" and not a behavior to emulate. "The study raises awareness of how extensive social media consumption can foster strong bonds with influencers, which could significantly impact your attitudes and behaviors." As with other social media trends, watching mukbang is not inherently wrong—it can be very entertaining. However, Burroughs advises being aware that it is branded content designed to stimulate your appetite. "This is part of the larger food branding and advertising system." Burroughs and Dam added that the study has implications for health and eating behavior experts. Watching mukbang can lead to overconsumption of unhealthy food. In conclusion, Burroughs and Dam write in their study that "researchers have not only found that watching food-related social media posts can increase food consumption but can [also] lead to negative health behaviors." They cite previous research showing "that Instagram use was associated with eating disorders, such as orthorexia nervosa, and obsession with healthy eating. Emerging research on mukbang revealed that mukbang viewing could lead to overconsumption."
translated_content: Da li ste se ikada uhvatili da gledate video influensera na društvenim mrežama koji konzumira ogromnu količinu, recimo, 100 različitih vrsta škampa? Teško je skrenuti pogled. Prije nego što shvatite, žudite za morskim plodovima, rezervišete sto u novom restoranu i tražite recepte. Riječ za ovu pojavu je: mukbang. Profesori žurnalistike i medijskih studija na UNLV-u, Linda Dam i Benjamin Burroughs, mogu objasniti zašto su ljudi toliko privučeni ovim videozapisima. Nedavno su oni—zajedno sa Anne Marie Basaran Borsai sa Univerziteta Connecticut—objavili svoj istraživački članak, '(Pre)Jedenje očima: Ispitivanje mukbang influenser marketinga i angažmana potrošača sa brendovima hrane,' u časopisu Journal of Promotion Management. Mukbang je video, koji se često nalazi na YouTube-u i TikTok-u, u kojem domaćin jede veliku količinu hrane dok komunicira s publikom. Prema Burroughsu i Dam, popularni mukbang influenseri često koriste specifične tehnike za razvoj parasocijalnih interakcija sa svojim pratiocima. Parasocijalni odnosi su neuzvratni odnosi koji se obično razvijaju sa medijskim ličnostima—vrsta odnosa u kojem se osjećate kao da dobro poznajete nekoga koga nikada niste upoznali. Na primjer, domaćin, često plaćeni influenser, preuveličava otvaranje paketa, glasno žvače i naglašava druge zvukove kako bi stvorio ASMR iskustvo. 'Autonomni senzorni meridijanski odgovor' odnosi se na trnce ili euforični osjećaj koji izazivaju određeni stimulansi—poput tapkanja noktima, zvukova krckanja ili šaputanja. Oni će također recenzirati hranu koju jedu u jednosmjernom razgovoru s publikom. O istraživanju Dam i Burroughs su proveli online anketu sa 404 učesnika iz SAD-a koji redovno gledaju mukbang videozapise. Istraživači su anketom procijenili: Pouzdanost Kredibilitet informacija Parasocijalnu interakciju Stavove prema videu Stavove prema brendu Namjere ponašanja Istraživači su pitali ispitanike da li vjeruju influenserima i da li su informacije koje pružaju vjerodostojne. Također su pitali da li su videozapisi dosadni ili uzbudljivi i da li su brendovi koji se pojavljuju privlačni ili ne. Učesnici su pitani koliko je vjerovatno da će jesti sličnu hranu prikazanu u videu. Studija je otkrila da veće ocjene u ovim područjima koreliraju sa jačim parasocijalnim odnosom, što poboljšava sposobnost influensera da prodaje proizvod i pozitivno utiče na popularnost brenda. Kao rezultat ovih parasocijalnih odnosa, gledaoci se osjećaju povezani s influenserom, razvijaju osjećaj intimnosti, vjeruju preporukama influensera i vjerovatnije je da će kupiti i konzumirati proizvod koji se promoviše. Šta društvo može naučiti iz studije? Nalazi istraživača nude praktične uvide za ambiciozne influensere hrane na društvenim mrežama i brendove koji ih angažuju. Što je još važnije, Burroughs napominje, to doprinosi široj raspravi o tome kako društvo—uključujući djecu i odrasle—može postati medijski pismenije. “Želimo da ljudi budu informisani i kritički potrošači ovog novog oblika sadržaja,” rekao je Burroughs. “Mislim da je to sastavni dio digitalne pismenosti, koji omogućava ljudima da razumiju sadržaj koji konzumiraju, zašto se kreira, ko stoji iza njegove produkcije i potencijalne ekonomske ili brendirane interese koji su uključeni.” Dam je objasnila da studija potiče gledaoce da razmotre psihološke efekte mukbanga i 'da prepoznaju da su velike količine hrane koje se konzumiraju dio čina kreiranja sadržaja' i da to nije ponašanje koje treba oponašati. 'Studija podiže svijest o tome kako opsežna konzumacija društvenih medija može potaknuti snažne veze s influenserima, što bi moglo značajno uticati na vaše stavove i ponašanje.' Kao i sa drugim trendovima na društvenim mrežama, gledanje mukbanga nije inherentno pogrešno—može biti vrlo zabavno. Međutim, Burroughs savjetuje da budete svjesni da je to brendirani sadržaj dizajniran da stimuliše vaš apetit. 'Ovo je dio većeg sistema brendiranja i oglašavanja hrane.' Burroughs i Dam su dodali da studija ima implikacije za stručnjake za zdravlje i ponašanje u ishrani. Gledanje mukbanga može dovesti do prekomjerne konzumacije nezdrave hrane. Zaključno, Burroughs i Dam pišu u svojoj studiji da 'istraživači nisu samo otkrili da gledanje objava na društvenim mrežama vezanih za hranu može povećati konzumaciju hrane, već može [također] dovesti do negativnih zdravstvenih ponašanja.' Oni navode prethodna istraživanja koja pokazuju 'da je upotreba Instagrama povezana s poremećajima u ishrani, kao što su ortoreksija nervoza, i opsesija zdravom ishranom. Istraživanja o mukbangu su otkrila da gledanje mukbanga može dovesti do prekomjerne konzumacije.'

article_content: Instead of somber commercials, British photographer Stuart Holroyd, age 34, is using uplifting dog portraits to assist a group of pups. Holroyd captures elaborate images of rescued shelter dogs to fund their care and help them find lasting homes. Holroyd's effort, 'The Bay Tree Project,' features dogs in various appealing settings, aiming to generate funds via a book and an exhibition scheduled for February. All proceeds will support the Bay Tree Boarding Kennels, an animal rescue in Larnaca managed by Kayte Wilson-Smith. Wilson-Smith's shelter houses approximately 60-70 dogs, sustained by her pension and community donations. The photographer wanted a 'more positive way' to show the problems and struggles that Kayte was facing. To date, 'The Bay Tree Project' has garnered over 3,207 euros (approximately 3,707 USD). Their Facebook page indicates the goal is to raise 5,000 euros, and six of the ten dogs photographed have been adopted already. Holroyd aims to refurbish the shelter 'so these animals can really have halfway house before their forever home.'
translated_content: Umjesto tužnih reklama, britanski fotograf Stuart Holroyd, star 34 godine, koristi vesele portrete pasa kako bi pomogao grupi štenaca. Holroyd pravi detaljne fotografije spašenih pasa iz azila da bi prikupio novac za njihovu njegu i pomogao im da pronađu stalne domove. Holroydov projekat, 'The Bay Tree Project,' prikazuje pse u raznim privlačnim okruženjima, sa ciljem da se prikupe sredstva putem knjige i izložbe koja je planirana za februar. Sav prihod ide za podršku Bay Tree Boarding Kennels, azilu za životinje u Larnaki kojim upravlja Kayte Wilson-Smith. U azilu Kayte Wilson-Smith boravi oko 60-70 pasa, a finansira se njenom penzijom i donacijama zajednice. Fotograf je htio da nađe 'pozitivniji način' da pokaže probleme i poteškoće sa kojima se Kayte susreće. Do sada je 'The Bay Tree Project' prikupio više od 3.207 eura (oko 3.707 američkih dolara). Na njihovoj Facebook stranici piše da je cilj prikupiti 5.000 eura, a šest od deset fotografisanih pasa je već usvojeno. Holroyd želi da renovira azil 'kako bi ove životinje imale privremeni dom prije nego što pronađu svoj zauvijek dom.'

article_content: A British charity, Greyhounds in Need (GIN), supported by Dame Judi Dench and Ricky Gervais, is dedicated to rescuing severely injured and abandoned greyhounds in Spain. These dogs often suffer extreme abuse, including being burned with cigarettes and acid, abandoned in tunnels, hung in trees, or released onto busy roads. Others are left with broken bones to starve. One greyhound was found with a rope embedded in its neck, requiring surgical removal. Many others have gaping wounds from abuse when discovered by volunteers across Spain. Shocking images documented by vets and volunteers are held by GIN, a Middlesex-based charity. Martin Humphery of GIN stated, 'They are awful pictures. It is very disturbing but sadly typical of the kind of things that is going on. There is supreme neglect and cruelty on a large scale.' GIN provides care for injured canines and has found homes for many rescued greyhounds in Britain and across Europe. Since 1998, the charity has rescued and treated approximately 6,000 to 7,000 greyhounds. Undercover video obtained by GIN reveals locally bred hunting greyhounds, known as galgos, being forced to keep pace with a moving vehicle while leashed, as part of their training for hare coursing. The video, showing five greyhounds being 'dragged' behind a truck, sparked outrage when presented at the Royal Society of Medicine in London. Humphery added, 'It is very clear that they are suffering greatly. We hope that it will finally help open eyes to the kind of abuse that is going on… There is supreme neglect and cruelty on a large scale. We have had cases of dogs being tied to rocks and left to starve to death, others with cigarette burns and some just thrown over fences and abandoned with broken legs.’ GIN collaborates with shelters across Spain, funding vets, treatment, shelters, and care. It also helps find homes for the dogs with families in Britain, Italy, Belgium, and France. When the hunting season ends, hunters often discard their greyhounds, purchasing new ones for the following season. GIN highlights cases like Fuga, a female galgo found with a severe neck wound from a rope. After being rescued by a volunteer and treated with GIN's support, she fully recovered and was adopted. The Spanish Galgo is uniquely capable of maintaining a fast pace for up to five minutes, making them ideal for hare coursing competitions. GIN's work involves funding vets, shelters, and treatments, as well as assisting in finding new homes for these animals. Prosecution for animal mistreatment in Spain is rare, and indifference is common. GIN appreciates the efforts of dedicated Spanish individuals who often face criticism for their work in helping galgos. According to GIN, the welfare of these dogs is not a priority for national and local governments in macho, rural communities. At the end of the coursing season, many dogs are abandoned and reported as 'missing.' For more information about GIN and adoption, visit www.greyhoundsinneed.co.uk or email info@greyhoundsinneed.co.uk.
translated_content: Britanska dobrotvorna organizacija, Greyhounds in Need (GIN), uz podršku Dame Judi Dench i Rickyja Gervaisa, posvećena je spašavanju teško ozlijeđenih i napuštenih hrtova u Španiji. Ovi psi često trpe ekstremno zlostavljanje, uključujući spaljivanje cigaretama i kiselinom, napuštanje u tunelima, vješanje na drveću ili puštanje na prometne ceste. Drugi su ostavljeni sa slomljenim kostima da umru od gladi. Jedan hrt je pronađen sa užetom urezanim u vrat, što je zahtijevalo hirurško uklanjanje. Mnogi drugi imaju zjapeće rane od zlostavljanja kada ih pronađu volonteri širom Španije. Šokantne slike koje su dokumentirali veterinari i volonteri čuva GIN, dobrotvorna organizacija sa sjedištem u Middlesexu. Martin Humphery iz GIN-a je izjavio: 'To su užasne slike. Vrlo je uznemirujuće, ali nažalost tipično za ono što se događa. Postoji vrhunsko zanemarivanje i okrutnost u velikim razmjerama.' GIN pruža njegu ozlijeđenim psima i pronašao je domove za mnoge spašene hrtove u Britaniji i širom Evrope. Od 1998. godine, dobrotvorna organizacija je spasila i liječila približno 6.000 do 7.000 hrtova. Tajni video snimljen od strane GIN-a otkriva lokalno uzgojene lovačke hrtove, poznate kao galgos, koji su prisiljeni držati korak s vozilom u pokretu dok su vezani, kao dio treninga za lov na zečeve. Video, koji prikazuje pet hrtova kako se 'vuku' iza kamiona, izazvao je bijes kada je prikazan u Kraljevskom medicinskom društvu u Londonu. Humphery je dodao: 'Vrlo je jasno da jako pate. Nadamo se da će to konačno pomoći da se otvore oči za vrstu zlostavljanja koja se događa... Postoji vrhunsko zanemarivanje i okrutnost u velikim razmjerama. Imali smo slučajeve pasa koji su bili vezani za stijene i ostavljeni da umru od gladi, drugi sa opekotinama od cigareta, a neki su jednostavno bačeni preko ograda i napušteni sa slomljenim nogama.' GIN sarađuje sa skloništima širom Španije, financirajući veterinare, liječenje, skloništa i njegu. Također pomaže u pronalaženju domova za pse s porodicama u Britaniji, Italiji, Belgiji i Francuskoj. Kada se sezone lova završi, lovci često odbacuju svoje hrtove, kupujući nove za sljedeću sezonu. GIN ističe slučajeve poput Fuge, ženke galgo pronađene sa teškom ranom na vratu od užeta. Nakon što ju je spasio volonter i liječio uz podršku GIN-a, potpuno se oporavila i usvojena je. Španski Galgo je jedinstveno sposoban održavati brzi tempo do pet minuta, što ih čini idealnim za takmičenja u lovu na zečeve. Rad GIN-a uključuje finansiranje veterinara, skloništa i liječenja, kao i pomoć u pronalaženju novih domova za ove životinje. Krivično gonjenje za zlostavljanje životinja u Španiji je rijetko, a ravnodušnost je uobičajena. GIN cijeni napore posvećenih španskih pojedinaca koji se često suočavaju s kritikama zbog svog rada na pomoći galgosima. Prema GIN-u, dobrobit ovih pasa nije prioritet za nacionalne i lokalne vlasti u mačo, ruralnim zajednicama. Na kraju sezone lova, mnogi psi su napušteni i prijavljeni kao 'nestali'. Za više informacija o GIN-u i usvajanju, posjetite www.greyhoundsinneed.co.uk ili pošaljite e-mail na info@greyhoundsinneed.co.uk.

article_content: Geraldine Cherry, a 50-year-old mother-of-two who has been blind for over 20 years, is accused of murdering her 70-year-old roommate. Cherry lost her eyesight after her eyes were gouged out during a prison fight in the 1980s at the Clinton Correctional Facility For Women in New Jersey. Last month, she was charged with the murder of Kathleen McEwan, a grandmother with special needs who required constant care. McEwan's body was discovered in their shared apartment in Roxborough, Philadelphia. Cherry and McEwan resided together under the care of Resources for Human Development, a social services agency. Initially, McEwan's death was believed to be from natural causes, and police found no initial reason to suspect foul play. However, undertakers preparing to embalm her body discovered ten inches of cotton rope, a candy wrapper, a lotion bottle, and a piece of a diaper in her throat, prompting a murder investigation. Jeff Thompson, from John J Byers Funeral Home, stated that he immediately suspected the cause of death was not natural upon seeing McEwan's body. 'I've done this for 20 some years, on thousands of people, and obviously I knew right away this didn't appear to be a natural cause of death,' Thompson said. 'We called the medical examiner.' According to Philly.com, Cherry reportedly told an RHD employee a few days after her arrest that she was a 'bad person' and 'did something', according to an affidavit. The extent of Cherry's troubled background has been revealed. Her sister, Brenda Cherry-Hamilton, 48, of Ohio, stated that she used to be 'scared to death' of her. 'My mom put locks on the inside of her door because of Geraldine,' she added. Mrs. Cherry-Hamilton disclosed that both she and Geraldine suffered physical and sexual abuse as children. The sisters, two of 16 siblings separated by social workers in 1974 and sent to different homes, shared a room in Ancora Psychiatric Hospital in New Jersey and in foster homes during their teenage years. Mrs. Cherry-Hamilton recounted, 'She used to tell me if I went to sleep she would choke me to death.' She added, 'My sister had a mental illness and she was violent, and I don't know why they would have put her together with another woman unsupervised. I feel terrible for this woman's family.' By 1980, Cherry had spent 2.5 years at the New Jersey Juvenile Justice Commission's Johnstone Campus. During her time there, 72 assault charges were recorded against her. In the same year, she pushed a woman onto a railway track and received a ten-year sentence at the Clinton Correctional Facility for Women. It was there that she lost her eyesight in a prison fight. Accounts from relatives vary, suggesting she was either stabbed in the eye with a pencil or broken glass, stabbed herself, or was stabbed by a prison officer. She was also charged with arson while in prison in 1986. Her lawyer, Fred Goodman, stated, 'We're very early in our investigation, but the one thing that is crystal clear is that she had the most horrific childhood imaginable.' article_content: Homs, Syria (CNN) -- A freelance cameraman recently in Homs created a video offering a rare look at life in the besieged city and a close-up of the Syrian opposition movement. At the headquarters of the government's secret police, the cameraman -- using the pseudonym 'Mani' to avoid government retribution upon his return -- found himself amid a battle. Approximately 200 members of the Free Syrian Army, comprised of military defectors, participated in the attack, detonating a bomb beneath a rooftop position where government snipers were stationed. CNN aired portions of the video on Friday, revealing an organized opposition communicating via walkie-talkies and engaged in intense combat. Casualties were transported by minibus to a makeshift field hospital, where they were placed on thin mats. 'My eye! My eye!' exclaimed a man who had been shot in the eye. Mani's camera tracked opposition fighters as they entered the government building, leading to room-to-room and stairwell combat. Eventually, under continued gunfire, the opposition fighters seized boxes of ammunition to continue their fight. Following a 20-hour battle, 15 opposition fighters were dead and 40 were wounded. The next day, local residents gutted the building. However, not all encounters were as violent. Mani noted instances where they successfully negotiated the surrender of government forces without firing a shot. 'They initially attempt negotiations,' Mani explained. 'They engage with the officer and soldiers, offering them the option to defect, surrender, or abandon the checkpoint. Sometimes, it succeeds.' Civilian volunteers are abundant and increasingly joined by government force defectors, according to Mani. Estimates suggest the FSA's strength exceeds 1,000 across Homs. Each neighborhood maintains its command, occasionally combining forces to enhance their chances against the larger, better-equipped government forces. The cameraman added that some soldiers, despite not deserting, sell weapons or ammunition to the opposition. 'Many sympathize with the opposition,' Mani stated. Down one street, his camera showed residents queuing outside a bakery. 'Due to the snipers, people are taking more bread than needed,' the distributor explained. 'Hence the crowding.' Two days prior, hundreds mourned the deaths of 138 people in overnight government shelling in a nearby district. With insufficient coffins, many were wrapped in white shrouds. 'Shelling civilians is the act of cowards,' the imam declared. 'Avoid public gatherings.' 'We are going to heaven!' the crowd chanted, raising their fists. Mani encountered a woman as she learned of her son's fatal shooting by a sniper. 'He is my son! My rock!' she cried. 'I have no man! He is my man!' Her son, a former regime supporter, had an 'Assad' tattoo on his chest near the bullet wound. Shelling spared a district two blocks away where many residents belonged to the Alawite sect, to which President Bashar al-Assad belongs. Homs is now divided along sectarian lines. CNN's Nic Robertson contributed to this report.

U sjedištu vladine tajne policije, snimatelj, koristeći pseudonim 'Mani' kako bi izbjegao odmazdu vlasti po povratku, našao se usred bitke. Žrtve su prevožene minibusom u improviziranu poljsku bolnicu, gdje su ih polagali na tanke strunjače. ‘Oko moje! Oko moje!’, uzviknuo je čovjek pogođen u oko. Snimatelj je dodao da neki vojnici, iako nisu dezertirali, prodaju oružje ili municiju opoziciji. ‘Mnogi suosjećaju s opozicijom’, izjavio je Mani. Niz ulicu, njegova je kamera snimila stanovnike kako čekaju u redu ispred pekare. ‘Zbog snajpera, ljudi uzimaju više kruha nego što im treba’, objasnio je distributer. ‘Zato je gužva.’ Dva dana ranije, stotine su ljudi žalovale za 138 poginulih u noćnom granatiranju vladinih snaga u obližnjem okrugu. Zbog nedostatka lijesova, mnogi su bili umotani u bijele pokrove. ‘Granatiranje civila je kukavički čin’, izjavio je imam. ‘Izbjegavajte javna okupljanja.’ ‘Idemo u raj!’, uzvikivala je gomila podižući šake. Mani je naišao na ženu koja je upravo saznala da je njen sin smrtno stradao od snajperskog hica. ‘Sine moj! Stijeno moja!’, plakala je. ‘Nemam nikoga! On je moj oslonac!’ Njen sin, bivši pristaša režima, imao je tetovažu s natpisom ‘Assad’ na prsima, blizu rane od metka. Granatiranje je poštedjelo okrug udaljen dva bloka, u kojem žive većinom pripadnici alavitske sekte kojoj pripada predsjednik Bashar al-Assad. Homs je sada podijeljen po sektaškim linijama. Nic Robertson s CNN-a pridonio je ovom izvještaju.

article_content: In Wales, a diver's discovery of a shiny object on the seabed nearly a decade ago unveiled a forgotten piece of local maritime history. Nine years prior, while exploring a shipwreck in shallow waters off the coast of Pembrokeshire, Welsh diver Rich Hughes spotted something glinting amidst the silt. Initially mistaking it for a coin, Hughes soon realized he'd found a complete silver pocket watch, still engraved with its owner's details. The inscription revealed the watch belonged to 'Richard Prichard, Abersoch, North Wales, 1866.' Driven by a belief that such a personal treasure deserved to be with family or in a local museum, Hughes embarked on a nine-year quest to uncover its past. After countless setbacks, Hughes's persistence paid off when he enlisted the help of a local historian, David Roberts, who identified Prichard as the captain of the iron barque 'Barbara'. Prichard tragically died at sea in 1881 and was buried there. The watch, likely a gift to Prichard upon his promotion in 1866, was lost when the 'Barbara' sank during its return voyage with a rice cargo. Captain Jones, who had taken over from Prichard, perished along with the ship after a navigational error in the Bristol Channel during a stormy November night. The only surviving relative, Owen Cowell, a retired dentist residing in Pwllheli near Abersoch, will receive the watch. Cowell plans to showcase it at the annual Abersoch village hall exhibition.

U početku misleći da je novčić, Hughes je ubrzo shvatio da je pronašao cijeli srebrni džepni sat, još uvijek ugraviran s podacima o vlasniku. Natpis je otkrio da je sat pripadao 'Richardu Prichardu, Abersoch, Sjeverni Vels, 1866'. Vođen uvjerenjem da takvo osobno blago zaslužuje biti s obitelji ili u lokalnom muzeju, Hughes se upustio u devetogodišnju potragu da otkrije njegovu prošlost. Nakon bezbrojnih prepreka, Hughesova upornost se isplatila kada je angažirao lokalnog povjesničara, Davida Robertsa, koji je identificirao Pricharda kao kapetana željeznog barka 'Barbara'. Prichard je tragično preminuo na moru 1881. godine i tamo je sahranjen. Sat, vjerojatno poklon Prichardu prilikom njegovog unapređenja 1866. godine, izgubljen je kada je 'Barbara' potonula tijekom povratnog putovanja s teretom riže. Kapetan Jones, koji je preuzeo dužnost od Pricharda, poginuo je zajedno s brodom nakon navigacijske greške u Bristolskom kanalu tijekom olujne novembarske noći. Jedini preživjeli rođak, Owen Cowell, penzionisani zubar koji živi u Pwllheliju blizu Abersocha, primit će sat. Cowell ga planira izložiti na godišnjoj izložbi u dvorani sela Abersoch.

article_content: A group of parents in Miami, Florida, are outraged that school officials allowed high school students to participate in an explicit rap music video featuring Juicy J and Lil Wayne, which referenced drugs and sex. Students from Miami Northwestern Senior High's band appeared in the video for 'Bands A Make Her Dance,' which features scantily clad women dancing around stripping poles and club scenes referencing drinking and drug use. Parents are shocked that the school gave permission for the students to wear their band uniforms for the racy footage, but the school claims they didn't know much about the artist before granting permission. The Miami high school said they were unaware of the song's theme when they allowed students to participate. Rapper Lil Wayne raps in front of members of the high school band. The school says the students filmed their portion in front of a green screen. Rapper Juicy J is also seen before members of the band, whose Miami Northwestern uniforms are clearly visible. In the video, the band members are standing at attention and playing their instruments, while the rappers perform in front of them. Shots of club partying and stripping are interspersed throughout the nearly 5-minute video, which was uploaded to YouTube on September 24. 'Bands' is a street term for a thousand dollars, and the high school students were seemingly included as an ironic gesture. Now, parents are shocked that the students were featured in such an explicit film. One band member plays during the rap performance. The music video glorifies stripping and the club scene. A representative for the school says that the students were by themselves during filming and were not engaged in or exposed to any of the activities presented in the film. 'The students were actually filmed by themselves,' John Schuster, the Miami-Dade County Public School’s spokesperson, told WBFS-TV regarding the filming that occurred at a warehouse in Miami’s Wynwood District. 'It’s a process called blue screen or green screening, where the students stand in front of a blue or green wall by themselves, and through video editing, they’re able to put it all together,' he explained. Shots of the students were interspersed with scenes of strippers. Parents and school officials were shocked when they viewed the film. Schuster explained that the school granted permission for the band to participate but admitted they did know about the performers beforehand. 'We did know who the main artist was, and parents did sign release forms,' Schuster added. A representative from the school's alumni association said they have reached out to Lil Wayne's management company in an attempt to address the situation. The school district is also said to be considering taking legal action over the incident.

article_content: Sales of foods free from ingredients such as nuts and wheat, which are said to cause allergies and other illnesses, are soaring. Increasing intolerance to wheat, dairy, and nuts means these ingredients are being removed from breads, biscuits, milk, and other foods on our shelves. Latest figures show that despite the premium price tag for these items, the ‘free from’ food market has grown by 50% in just two years. Consumers are abandoning foods containing wheat and nuts, such as bread, due to allergy fears. Data from market research firm Kantar shows the market is worth £360 million, up from £240 million in 2012. Tesco, which is launching a range of products including nut-free peanut butter to capitalize on the growing demand, says the boom is particularly driven by products free of wheat and its protein gluten. These products, which can cost up to eight times as much as standard versions, include breads, cereals, and cakes in which wheat-based flour is replaced with gluten-free flour from rice, corn, or other sources. Other foods are being sought out by those intolerant to lactose or whose children are allergic to peanuts. Retail giant Tesco has even started selling nut-free peanut butter because of the demand for allergy-conscious products. However, while many are being bought by people with a genuine medical problem, it is feared that the bulk of the rise is being fueled by the ‘worried well’. Researchers at Portsmouth University found that nine in ten Britons who believe they have a food allergy or intolerance are perfectly healthy. The researchers concluded that although 20% of adults – about 10 million – claim they are unable to eat foods from milk to mustard, fewer than 2% actually have a diagnosed allergy or intolerance. They blamed internet searches, self-testing kits, and celebrity food fads for the perceived epidemic of allergies and intolerances.
translated_content: Prodaja hrane bez sastojaka poput orašastih plodova i pšenice, za koje se kaže da uzrokuju alergije i druge bolesti, naglo raste. Sve veća netolerancija na pšenicu, mliječne proizvode i orašaste plodove znači da se ti sastojci uklanjaju iz kruha, keksa, mlijeka i ostalih prehrambenih proizvoda na našim policama. Najnoviji podaci pokazuju da je, unatoč višoj cijeni ovih proizvoda, tržište hrane 'bez' poraslo za 50% u samo dvije godine. Potrošači izbjegavaju hranu koja sadrži pšenicu i orašaste plodove, poput kruha, zbog straha od alergija. Podaci tvrtke za istraživanje tržišta Kantar pokazuju da je vrijednost tržišta 360 milijuna funti, u odnosu na 240 milijuna funti u 2012. godini. Tesco, koji lansira niz proizvoda, uključujući maslac od kikirikija bez orašastih plodova kako bi iskoristio rastuću potražnju, tvrdi da je procvat potaknut proizvodima bez pšenice i proteina gluten. Ti proizvodi, koji mogu koštati i do osam puta više od standardnih, uključuju kruh, žitarice i kolače gdje se brašno na bazi pšenice zamjenjuje bezglutenskim brašnom od riže, kukuruza ili drugih izvora. Drugu hranu traže osobe netolerantne na laktozu ili čija su djeca alergična na kikiriki. Maloprodajni lanac Tesco je čak počeo prodavati maslac od kikirikija bez orašastih plodova zbog potražnje za proizvodima koji su prilagođeni osobama s alergijama. Međutim, iako mnogi takve proizvode kupuju zbog stvarnih zdravstvenih problema, strahuje se da je veći dio potražnje potaknut od strane 'zdravih koji su zabrinuti'. Istraživači sa Sveučilišta Portsmouth su otkrili da je devet od deset Britanaca koji vjeruju da imaju alergiju ili intoleranciju na hranu zapravo potpuno zdravo. Istraživači su zaključili da, iako 20% odraslih osoba – oko 10 milijuna – tvrdi da ne može jesti hranu od mlijeka do senfa, manje od 2% ima dijagnosticiranu alergiju ili intoleranciju. Okrivili su pretraživanje interneta, komplete za samotestiranje i prehrambene trendove slavnih za percipiranu epidemiju alergija i intolerancija.

article_content: Is 'Teen Mom 2' following the path of 'Jersey Shore'? According to the NY Post, the reality show's 'days are numbered' due to Jenelle Evans's behavior. The series chronicles the lives of four women who became pregnant during their high school years. The Post reports that Evans, after a period in rehab, got married, experienced another pregnancy, reportedly suffered a miscarriage, and then publicly requested a divorce via a profanity-filled tweet. The paper suggests the network plans to discontinue the show because of Evans's 'out-of-control antics.' However, MTV assured EW that no decision has been made regarding the show's future. 'No decision has been made yet regarding a fifth season of Teen Mom 2,' a network spokesperson stated. 'But the network is planning to air the fourth season this year and will announce the premiere date soon.' With 3.4 million viewers tuning in for the show's third season premiere in September, there's a strong argument that the show could simply recast one of its contestants if Evans is the primary concern. The network might also consider focusing on more upscale content, given its significant investment in scripted programs like 'Awkward' and 'Teen Wolf.' MTV gave its original 'Teen Mom' a series finale in 2012 (however, the network also returned to reality programming with 'Buckwild'). Stay tuned for updates...
