article_content: London (CNN) -- U.S. President Barack Obama did not fulfill his 2008 campaign promise to close the Guantanamo Bay prison camp at a U.S. naval base in Cuba, partly because international attention waned. Europeans, initially pleased by his election and his pledge to end Bush-era torture practices that had damaged the U.S. reputation, assumed he would follow through on his commitment. It has taken several years to realize that he missed his 2010 self-imposed deadline to close the facility. For many, this realization has been driven by the Guantanamo detainees themselves, who, lacking other means to express their despair, are now engaging in a large-scale hunger strike. The U.S. military acknowledges that over 50 of the 166 detainees are participating. However, Reprieve suggests, based on unclassified phone calls with clients, that the actual number exceeds 130. Among them are individuals with strong connections to Europe. Shaker Aamer, a London resident with a British wife and four children in the UK, has been twice cleared for release by both the Bush and Obama administrations. Successive British governments have requested his return, yet he remains in Guantanamo more than a decade after being taken into U.S. custody. Two weeks ago, he informed his lawyer, Reprieve's Clive Stafford Smith, that he had joined the hunger strike and had lost over 30 pounds. "I can't read. I am dizzy and I fall down all the time," he said, adding "My back and my neck are getting worse day by day. I don't want to end up paralyzed. I want to be able to carry my kids when I get home." Nabil Hadjarab's father and grandfather served in the French army. He wishes to return to his family in France. His uncle, Ahmad Hadjarab, stated: "I am asking America for humanity, and asking France for gratitude." However, Nabil has received neither. He has lost so much weight that he is being force-fed by Guantanamo personnel, restrained in a chair while a tube is inserted into his nose and throat—a procedure the World Medical Association describes as inhuman and degrading. Nabil was cleared for release in 2007. More than five years after the U.S. determined he posed no threat, he is still detained in Guantanamo. On Wednesday night, he told his lawyer during an unclassified call that he had "lost all hope of ever being released." Younus Chekkouri, another detainee, hopes to reunite with his family in Germany. He too is on hunger strike. In a recent unclassified call, he told Reprieve: "The nightmare has started again. For some time, things had improved here ...but now it has changed again ... really, now it is just pain everywhere. I don't want to die in Guantanamo." Like Shaker and Nabil, Younus has never been tried or charged with a crime, and U.S. authorities have cleared him for release. Many more in Guantanamo are in similar situations—stuck in limbo without an end in sight, deprived of basic legal principles. The hope that arose with President Obama's election, when he promised to close Guantanamo, now seems like a cruel joke. It is easy to understand their desperation. As Shaker recently stated, "a little over 50% of the prisoners have been told they can go home -- or go somewhere -- but [they] are still here." On Thursday, the European Parliament scheduled an urgent hearing on the Guantanamo hunger strike. The debate is important. Europe must realize that this issue extends beyond the U.S.; it is also a European problem. European intelligence services collaborated with the U.S. in implementing the flawed policies of the "War on Terror," which led to the detention, "rendition," and torture of many innocent individuals who were simply in the wrong place at the wrong time. Europe has long tolerated the U.S.'s disregard for the rule of law concerning individuals who deserve European government support. Hopefully, this debate marks a step toward rectifying this. The motion includes positive elements: a call for Europe to re-engage, demand the closure of Guantanamo, and, significantly, offer to resettle the dozen or so prisoners cleared for release but unable to return home due to the risk of torture. If Europe acts on this, there is still hope that men like Shaker, Nabil, and Younous may one day reunite with their families. The opinions expressed in this commentary are solely those of Polly Rossdale.
translated_content: London (CNN) -- Američki predsjednik Barack Obama nije ispunio svoje predizborno obećanje iz 2008. da zatvori zatvor Guantanamo Bay u američkoj pomorskoj bazi na Kubi, dijelom i zbog toga što je međunarodna pažnja popustila. Evropljani, u početku zadovoljni njegovim izborom i obećanjem da će okončati prakse mučenja iz Bushove ere koje su narušile ugled SAD-a, pretpostavili su da će ispuniti svoje obećanje. Trebalo je nekoliko godina da shvate da je propustio svoj samonametnuti rok iz 2010. za zatvaranje tog objekta. Za mnoge, ovo saznanje je potaknuto od strane samih zatvorenika iz Guantanama, koji, nemajući drugih načina da izraze svoj očaj, sada sudjeluju u velikom štrajku glađu. Američka vojska priznaje da preko 50 od 166 zatvorenika sudjeluje u štrajku. Međutim, Reprieve sugerira, na temelju neklasificiranih telefonskih poziva sa svojim klijentima, da stvarni broj prelazi 130. Među njima su pojedinci sa jakim vezama sa Evropom. Shaker Aamer, stanovnik Londona sa britanskom suprugom i četvero djece u Velikoj Britaniji, je dva puta bio odobren za puštanje na slobodu od strane Bushove i Obamine administracije. Uzastopne britanske vlade su tražile njegov povratak, ali on i dalje ostaje u Guantanamu više od desetljeća nakon što je odveden u američki pritvor. Prije dva tjedna je obavijestio svog odvjetnika, Clivea Stafforda Smitha iz Reprievea, da se pridružio štrajku glađu i da je izgubio preko 30 funti. "Ne mogu čitati. Vrti mi se i stalno padam", rekao je, dodavši: "Leđa i vrat mi se iz dana u dan pogoršavaju. Ne želim završiti paraliziran. Želim moći nositi svoju djecu kad se vratim kući." Otac i djed Nabila Hadjaraba su služili u francuskoj vojsci. On želi da se vrati svojoj obitelji u Francuskoj. Njegov ujak, Ahmad Hadjarab, je izjavio: "Tražim od Amerike humanost, a od Francuske zahvalnost." Međutim, Nabil nije dobio ni jedno ni drugo. Izgubio je toliko kilograma da ga osoblje Guantanama prisilno hrani, držeći ga vezanog za stolicu dok mu se cijev ubacuje u nos i grlo – postupak koji Svjetska liječnička udruga opisuje kao nehuman i ponižavajući. Nabil je odobren za puštanje na slobodu 2007. godine. Više od pet godina nakon što su SAD utvrdile da ne predstavlja prijetnju, on je još uvijek zatočen u Guantanamu. U srijedu navečer je rekao svom odvjetniku tokom neklasificiranog poziva da je "izgubio svaku nadu da će ikada biti pušten." Younus Chekkouri, još jedan zatvorenik, se nada ponovnom susretu sa svojom obitelji u Njemačkoj. I on je u štrajku glađu. U nedavnom neklasificiranom pozivu je rekao Reprieveu: "Noćna mora je opet počela. Neko vrijeme su se stvari ovdje popravile... ali sada se opet promijenilo... zaista, sada je samo bol svuda. Ne želim umrijeti u Guantanamu." Kao i Shaker i Nabil, Younusu nikada nije suđeno niti je optužen za bilo kakav zločin, a američke vlasti su ga odobrile za puštanje na slobodu. Mnogi drugi u Guantanamu su u sličnim situacijama – zaglavljeni u limbu bez kraja na vidiku, lišeni osnovnih pravnih načela. Nada koja se pojavila sa izborom predsjednika Obame, kada je obećao da će zatvoriti Guantanamo, sada izgleda kao okrutna šala. Lako je razumjeti njihov očaj. Kao što je Shaker nedavno izjavio: "Malo više od 50% zatvorenika je dobilo poruku da mogu ići kući – ili negdje – ali [oni] su još uvijek ovdje." U četvrtak je Europski parlament zakazao hitnu raspravu o štrajku glađu u Guantanamu. Rasprava je važna. Europa mora shvatiti da se ovo pitanje proteže izvan SAD-a; to je i europski problem. Europske obavještajne službe su surađivale sa SAD-om u provedbi pogrešnih politika "Rata protiv terora", što je dovelo do pritvaranja, "izručenja" i mučenja mnogih nevinih pojedinaca koji su se jednostavno našli na pogrešnom mjestu u pogrešno vrijeme. Europa je dugo tolerirala zanemarivanje vladavine zakona od strane SAD-a u vezi sa pojedincima koji zaslužuju podršku europske vlade. Nadamo se da ova rasprava označava korak prema ispravljanju ovoga. Prijedlog uključuje pozitivne elemente: poziv Europi da se ponovno uključi, zahtijeva zatvaranje Guantanama i, značajno, nudi preseljenje desetak zatvorenika koji su odobreni za puštanje na slobodu, ali se ne mogu vratiti kući zbog rizika od mučenja. Ako Europa djeluje po ovom pitanju, još uvijek postoji nada da će se ljudi poput Shakera, Nabila i Younusa jednog dana ponovno sjediniti sa svojim obiteljima. Mišljenja izražena u ovom komentaru su isključivo mišljenja Polly Rossdale.

article_content: A thief has been caught on camera stealing a wallet containing £450 from a vulnerable 97-year-old man. A slender, 5ft 6in woman of eastern European or Asian descent was captured by CCTV distracting pensioner Leslie Parsonage by asking him for the time. While the man was looking at his watch, she swiped his wallet, which contained £450 of his pension money, from his jacket pocket before walking off and putting on a white hat. A possible male accomplice was also seen near the scene of the crime on Fryern Arcade in Chandler’s Ford, Hampshire. The stress of the incident is believed to have led to Mr. Parsonage being rushed to Southampton General Hospital for treatment for a blood clot in his left leg. Fortunately, the victim initially pulled through, but his family believes the traumatic ordeal subsequently led to his health deteriorating. At one stage, they were warned he might not survive. The distraught pensioner has since vowed never to return to the shopping arcade, even though it was his only weekly outing. Mr. Parsonage’s great-nephew, Russell Leggett, said today: 'My biggest worry is that this woman will do this again to another elderly, vulnerable person. 'It could end up being life-threatening for someone of that age, but these thieves don’t think about that. 'He ended up in hospital possibly as a result of the theft because doctors believe the stress could have triggered it all. It is disgusting what she has done. 'He was obviously frail and vulnerable; he had his white stick with him, and yet she still struck. This has really affected him and changed his life. It may have even shortened it.' 'We just hope that if anyone recognizes her from the images, they will come forward and help stop her from doing it again.' The distraction theft is similar to those carried out by other eastern Europeans and spotted by cameras in Paris last week. At least three members of a Roma gang were seen trying to distract and steal money from a pensioner as he withdrew money from a cashpoint. In Britain, distraction thefts are commonly associated with organized gangs of petty thieves. This year, cashpoint card snatches have reportedly tripled, with Romanian crime gangs responsible for 92 per cent of thefts from cash machines.

U Britaniji se krađe ometanjem obično povezuju s organiziranim bandama sitnih lopova. article_content: In Alabama, a teenager named Derek Shrout was granted bail on Monday, just two days after being arrested on suspicion of planning 'terrorist attacks' at his high school. During a court appearance in Russell County, District Judge David Johnson set Shrout's bail at $75,000, according to prosecutor Buster Landreau. Reports from CNN affiliates WRBL and WTVM indicate that the teen entered a not guilty plea to the charge of attempted assault. The 17-year-old's arrest followed the discovery of a journal by a teacher at Russell County High School. Sheriff Heath Taylor stated on Saturday that the journal contained several plans resembling potential terrorist attacks and violent threats against the school. The sheriff further noted that six students and one teacher were specifically mentioned in the plans. 'He clearly invested considerable thought into this,' Sheriff Taylor said. 'It was evident that this was more than just a fictional story written in a journal.' Shrout's attorney, Jeremy Armstrong, told reporters in court that 'this was merely talk from my client.' He added, 'I don't believe he intended to harm anyone,' as reported by several media outlets, including WRBL. Over the weekend, authorities displayed 25 tobacco tins and two larger ones to reporters. These tins had holes drilled into them and contained pellets similar to BBs. Sheriff Taylor explained that experts consulted by investigators concluded that with the addition of a few more elements, the tins 'would definitely explode exactly as he described in his writing.' The sheriff stated that 'these devices were very close to being ready to explode.' The suspect has been described as a white supremacist, though it is unclear if he is affiliated with any specific group, according to Taylor's statement to the Southern Poverty Law Center, a civil rights organization. David Kelly, the senior class president at Russell County High School, mentioned to WTVM that Shrout initially showed promise through JROTC, but his behavior shifted towards 'the whole white power thing' over time. Shrout began writing in the journal shortly after the tragic massacre at an elementary school in Newtown, Connecticut, last month, which resulted in the deaths of 27 people, including the shooter. Sheriff Taylor suggested that the school shooting 'was potentially the catalyst that led him to start writing down his plans.' However, Shrout's lawyer suggested that his client's case might be 'blown a little out of proportion, considering what happened in Newtown.' Armstrong stated, 'Of course, everyone in our nation is on edge.' Under the conditions set by the judge on Monday, Shrout must remain at home and wear an electronic monitoring device, according to Landreau. He is also prohibited from contacting anyone at his school. His next court appearance is scheduled for February 12, as confirmed by Landreau.

Tokom pojavljivanja pred sudom u okrugu Russell, okružni sudija David Johnson odredio je Shroutovu jamčevinu na 75.000 dolara, prema riječima tužioca Bustera Landreaua. Izvještaji CNN-ovih filijala WRBL i WTVM ukazuju da se tinejdžer izjasnio da nije kriv po optužbi za pokušaj napada. Hapšenje 17-godišnjaka uslijedilo je nakon što je učitelj u srednjoj školi okruga Russell pronašao dnevnik. Šerif Heath Taylor izjavio je u subotu da dnevnik sadrži nekoliko planova koji podsjećaju na potencijalne terorističke napade i nasilne prijetnje školi. Šerif je dalje napomenuo da je šest učenika i jedan nastavnik posebno spomenuto u planovima. 'Očigledno je uložio značajnu misao u ovo', rekao je šerif Taylor. 'Bilo je očito da je ovo više od izmišljene priče napisane u dnevniku.' Shroutov advokat, Jeremy Armstrong, rekao je novinarima na sudu da je 'ovo bio samo razgovor od strane mog klijenta.' Dodao je: 'Ne vjerujem da je imao namjeru da nekome naudi', kako su izvijestili brojni mediji, uključujući WRBL. Tokom vikenda, vlasti su novinarima pokazale 25 limenki duhana i dvije veće. Ove limenke su imale izbušene rupe i sadržavale su kuglice slične BB mecima. Šerif Taylor je objasnio da su stručnjaci koje su konsultovale vlasti zaključili da bi uz dodatak još nekoliko elemenata, limenke 'definitivno eksplodirale tačno kako je opisao u svom pisanju.' Šerif je izjavio da su 'ovi uređaji bili vrlo blizu toga da budu spremni za eksploziju.' Osumnjičeni je opisan kao bijeli supremacista, iako nije jasno da li je povezan sa bilo kojom specifičnom grupom, prema Taylorovoj izjavi za Southern Poverty Law Center, organizaciju za građanska prava. David Kelly, predsjednik starijeg razreda u srednjoj školi okruga Russell, spomenuo je za WTVM da je Shrout u početku pokazivao obećanje kroz JROTC, ali se njegovo ponašanje vremenom preusmjerilo na 'cijelu tu stvar sa bijelom moći.' Shrout je počeo pisati u dnevnik ubrzo nakon tragičnog masakra u osnovnoj školi u Newtownu, Connecticut, prošlog mjeseca, što je rezultiralo smrću 27 ljudi, uključujući i pucača. Šerif Taylor je sugerisao da je pucnjava u školi 'potencijalno bila katalizator koji ga je naveo da počne zapisivati svoje planove.' Međutim, Shroutov advokat je sugerisao da bi slučaj njegovog klijenta mogao biti 'malo preuveličan, s obzirom na ono što se dogodilo u Newtownu.' Armstrong je izjavio: 'Naravno, svi u našoj naciji su napeti.' Prema uslovima koje je sudija postavio u ponedjeljak, Shrout mora ostati kod kuće i nositi elektronski uređaj za nadzor, prema riječima Landreaua. Također mu je zabranjeno da kontaktira bilo koga u svojoj školi. Njegovo sljedeće pojavljivanje pred sudom zakazano je za 12. februar, kako je potvrdio Landreau.

article_content: In New York, a resourceful burglar tunneled through a hallway wall to gain entry into a residence, making off with valuable jewelry, watches, and artwork by Andy Warhol and Roy Lichtenstein. According to NYPD spokesman Sgt. John Buthorn, the stolen items are valued between $500,000 and $1 million. The homeowners were away for the Thanksgiving holiday when the burglary occurred. Police have not released the identities of the residents or the apartment's location. Among the stolen items was 'Camouflage,' a set of eight signed Warhol prints in various colors, representing the American artist's abstract interpretation of a familiar pattern. Other stolen prints included Lichtenstein's 'Thinking Nude' and 'Moonscape,' as well as Warhol's 'The Truck' and 'Superman.' An oil painting titled 'Live Cat' by British artist Carl Fudge was also taken. Police are requesting the public's assistance in locating the suspect, who remains at large. CNN's Chris Kokenes contributed to this report.

Prema riječima glasnogovornika NYPD-a, narednika Johna Buthorna, ukradeni predmeti su procijenjeni na vrijednost između 500.000 i 1 milion dolara. Vlasnici kuće su bili odsutni tokom praznika Dana zahvalnosti kada se dogodila provala. Policija nije objavila identitet stanara niti lokaciju stana. Među ukradenim predmetima bio je 'Camouflage', set od osam potpisanih Warholovih grafika u različitim bojama, koji predstavlja apstraktnu interpretaciju poznatog uzorka od strane američkog umjetnika. Ostali ukradeni otisci uključuju Lichtensteinove 'Thinking Nude' i 'Moonscape', kao i Warholove 'The Truck' i 'Superman'. Chris Kokenes sa CNN-a je doprinio ovom izvještaju.

article_content: Newcastle United's Sandro Tonali and Aston Villa's Nicolò Zaniolo have been dismissed from the Italian national team. This action follows their implication, along with Juventus' Nicolò Fagioli, in a probe regarding unlawful betting. Reports from the Italian media indicate that police visited Italy's training camp in Coverciano at 5:40 p.m. local time to question the players. Subsequently, the Italian FA (FIGC) decided to send Tonali and Zaniolo back to their respective Premier League teams. The Italian team is preparing to play against Malta on Saturday, followed by a match against England on Tuesday. Luciano Spalletti, the team's manager, has called up Samuele Ricci from Torino and Stephan El Sharaawy from Roma as replacements. It's being reported that any potential ban for Tonali and Zaniolo would be effective globally. According to La Repubblica, additional players may be named as the investigation unfolds. Fagioli's lawyer stated that the player proactively contacted authorities regarding the betting allegations. Reports confirmed on Friday that Fagioli has admitted to the offenses and provided his mobile phone as evidence. Turin Chief Prosecutor Enrica Gabetta has verified that Fagioli is under investigation, and the FIGC has initiated its own proceedings. While the specific type of gambling activity has not been disclosed, FIGC regulations stipulate that players gambling on football face a minimum three-year ban and a €25,000 fine. Lawyer Luca Ferrari stated that Nicolò Fagioli remains calm and focused on Juventus and the upcoming season. He added that Fagioli is collaborating with authorities with transparency. Fagioli has played six games for Juventus this season, after first appearing under Max Allegri in 2022/23, making 17 starts, scoring three goals, and providing three assists. Tonali has quickly become an integral player for Newcastle under Eddie Howe since his summer transfer from Milan, with seven Premier League appearances and two Champions League starts. Zaniolo, currently on loan to Aston Villa from Galatasaray, has played in six matches under Unai Emery.
translated_content: Sandro Tonali iz Newcastle Uniteda i Nicolò Zaniolo iz Aston Ville su udaljeni iz italijanske reprezentacije. Ova akcija slijedi nakon njihove umiješanosti, zajedno sa Nicolò Fagiolijem iz Juventusa, u istragu u vezi sa nezakonitim klađenjem. Izvještaji italijanskih medija ukazuju na to da je policija posjetila italijanski trening kamp u Covercianu u 17:40 po lokalnom vremenu kako bi ispitala igrače. Nakon toga, Italijanski nogometni savez (FIGC) je odlučio da vrati Tonalija i Zaniola nazad u njihove klubove u Premier ligi. Italijanska reprezentacija se priprema za utakmicu protiv Malte u subotu, nakon čega slijedi utakmica protiv Engleske u utorak. Luciano Spalletti, selektor tima, pozvao je Samuelea Riccija iz Torina i Stephana El Sharaawyja iz Rome kao zamjene. Izvještava se da bi svaka potencijalna zabrana za Tonalija i Zaniola bila efektivna na globalnom nivou. Prema La Repubblici, dodatni igrači bi mogli biti imenovani kako se istraga bude razvijala. Fagiolijev advokat je izjavio da je igrač proaktivno kontaktirao vlasti u vezi sa optužbama za klađenje. Izvještaji su potvrdili u petak da je Fagioli priznao prekršaje i predao svoj mobilni telefon kao dokaz. Tužiteljica iz Torina, Enrica Gabetta, potvrdila je da je Fagioli pod istragom, a FIGC je pokrenuo vlastiti postupak. Iako specifična vrsta aktivnosti klađenja nije otkrivena, FIGC propisi nalažu da se igrači koji se klade na nogomet suočavaju s minimalnom trogodišnjom zabranom i novčanom kaznom od 25.000 eura. Advokat Luca Ferrari je izjavio da Nicolò Fagioli ostaje smiren i fokusiran na Juventus i nadolazeću sezonu. Dodao je da Fagioli sarađuje s vlastima uz maksimalnu transparentnost. Fagioli je odigrao šest utakmica za Juventus ove sezone, nakon što se prvi put pojavio pod vodstvom Maxa Allegrija 2022/23, upisavši 17 nastupa, postigavši tri gola i tri asistencije. Tonali je brzo postao ključni igrač za Newcastle pod vodstvom Eddieja Howea od svog ljetnog transfera iz Milana, sa sedam nastupa u Premier ligi i dva nastupa u Ligi prvaka. Zaniolo, trenutno na posudbi u Aston Villi iz Galatasaraya, odigrao je šest utakmica pod vodstvom Unaija Emeryja.
